messages:
Alex: Heads-up — after last night's firmware rollout in ap-northeast-3 a subset of OOB BMCs are keeping TCP sessions open and toggling secure-boot bits on next reboot. GPUs are getting stuck in provisioning queue, ~120 nodes failing attestation :rotating_light:

Nina: seeing same in our metrics. kube-provision logs show `attestation_failed: secureboot_mismatch` and nodes stuck in PREBOOT for >10m. :eyes:

Alex: logs snippet:
```
Apr 12 03:21:07 bmc-1023 kernel: secureboot: dbx bit changed (0x1 -> 0x0)
fleet-provisioner: node 10.0.32.45: attestation_failed
oobd: sess=0x7fa9 keepalive from 10.0.32.45, but no tty
```

Chris: root cause looks like new keepalive semantics in the controller. It leaves sessions ESTABLISHED after the fw bump and the session_gc job is erroring with timeouts. ops-bot reported 429s on session_gc.

ops-bot: session_gc job failure 3/3 — reason=timeout, runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oob-session-gc.md

Nina: temporary workaround — forced `fleetctl oob restart-controller --region apne3` which unblocked ~30 nodes. Staggering restarts rack-by-rack now.

Alex: we can also purge stale sessions: `fleetctl oob purge-sessions --region apne3 --older-than 5m --filter secureboot=true`. Doing a canary first.

Chris: starting purge against canary rack rck-11 now. Will monitor attestation logs.

Leah: cost note — backlog is holding reserved GPU capacity; finance estimate ~+$8k/day if this continues. Notifying account owners.

Jon: I'm oncall, creating an incident ticket and paging firmware. @sre-oncall can you join the call?

sre-oncall: joining, on VOIP. What are the exact customer-visible impacts?

Nina: impact = provisioning queue latency x3, 4% of jobs failing to start, autoscaler keeps adding nodes which hits capacity and causes tail latencies for Dedicated customers.

Alex: after purge canary: 28/30 recovered, 2 nodes show persistent NVRAM/secureboot mismatch. Escalating to firmware for targeted rollback of keepalive change.

Chris: opened FW issue #4521 (eng-firmware). Proposed action: 1) revert keepalive semantics 2) backfill robust session GC + retries 3) slow rollout with health gates.

Leah: finance alert created and Dedicated customers moved to alternate GPU pools where possible to reduce customer impact.

Alex: postmortem TODOs: add automated detector for `sess_count>100 && secureboot_toggle>0` during 02:00-06:00 windows, add `--dry-run` option to purge-sessions, and add canary-health metrics to rollout pipeline.

Jon: ack. I'll post a short timeline to #incidents and link this thread. For now, pause the remainder of the rollout.

ops-bot: Rollout paused by ops-bot at 4471234569 — reason=out_of_band_conn_retention_high

Alex: thanks all. Keep updates here. I'll write a blameless summary tomorrow and coordinate FW rollback schedule.
